title: evolve ci classify reads a chosen run attempt, not only the latest
summary: evolve ci classify reads only the latest attempt of a run. After a rerun turns a flaky red green, the red of attempt 1 cannot be classified, so the flake evidence is lost (seen on #1126: TestRealTmux_AFailedStartLeavesNoEnvFile red on attempt 1, green on attempt 2).
fix: Add an attempt selector to evolve ci classify (for example --attempt N, and an all-attempts mode) that reads the jobs and logs of that attempt, and records the attempt in the JSON envelope.
acceptance: RED first: TestCIClassify_ReadsTheChosenAttempt (a fake API with a red attempt 1 and a green attempt 2) fails before
classify --attempt 1 labels the red of attempt 1, and the default stays the latest attempt
Changed functions at 100% coverage on every CI OS; the runtime reference names the flag
